messages:
Renee (People Ops): Quick heads-up: we've published two related updates today  (1) Compassionate Care Leave expansion (bereavement + short-term caregiver leave) and (2) a Travel Safety Pledge and reporting flow for employees on work travel. Full policy + FAQ: https://redwood.internal/hr/compassionate-travel :heart:

Omar (IC): Does this change bereavement pay?

Renee (People Ops): Short version: paid bereavement increased to 10 workdays for immediate family (up from 5) and 3 days for extended family. Added a 14-day short-term caregiver leave (paid) for unexpected medical caregiving. Both effective 2026-06-01; retroactive consideration back to 2026-03-01 for qualifying events.

Taylor (Manager): Any manager approvals needed for caregiver leave?

Renee (People Ops): Managers confirm coverage and log the leave in Workday; no extra paperwork beyond a short attestation and any supporting documentation you choose to submit. We prioritized a low-friction flow to avoid burdening people in stressful times.

Marta (Legal): Note: payroll will show caregiver/bereavement lines separately. There are jurisdiction-specific rules—check the FAQ for local variations. Our doc also reminds teams to avoid requesting medical details beyond what is necessary; send questions to People Ops rather than employees.

Diego (Security): Travel Safety Pledge  what does it require?

Renee (People Ops): For any business travel, employees will be asked to acknowledge the Travel Safety Pledge in the travel booking flow. Key points: follow local laws, maintain professional boundaries, do not share sensitive client data over unsecured networks, and report any safety incidents within 24 hours via the new incident form. The pledge is brief; it's not punitive, it9s about clarity and support. :lock:

hr-bot: Policy pages updated: https://redwood.internal/hr/compassionate-travel. Training: 15-min micro-module available in LMS under "Travel Safety".

Omar (IC): If something happens while abroad (medical event or harassment), who's the first contact?

Diego (Security): If it's an immediate safety issue call the local emergency services. Then use the incident form or call Security (24/7) listed on the policy page. People Ops will coordinate emergency leave, housing, and travel home as needed.

Priya (People Ops): Expense codes for travel/leave reimbursements: COMP-BEREAVE, COMP-CAREGIVER, TRAVEL-SAFETY-AID. Submit receipts and brief notes where applicable. Finance will flag these for expedited processing.

Taylor (Manager): Appreciate the clarity. Can contractors access any of this?

Renee (People Ops): Contractors are eligible for the Travel Safety Pledge and emergency travel support triaged case-by-case. Paid bereavement and caregiver leave are for employees only; see the FAQ for contractor support guidelines.

Renee (People Ops): We'll host two 30-min Q&A sessions (Mon 11am PT, Fri 4pm PT). If you need an urgent exception, DM People Ops or use #people-ops-emergencies. Please read the FAQ and flag any unclear language here and we'll update. :handshake:
